infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Camera is required to capture Proof of Delivery (POD) photos and expense receipts.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Photo library access is required to attach delivery or expense images.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Permission is required to save captured delivery photos.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Location is used to record GPS coordinates for trip tracking and expense logging.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Location is used to continuously track your trip route and sync GPS updates with dispatch.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Microphone access is required for voice-to-text expense description input.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to access photo library to attach Proof of Delivery and receipts.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to access camera to capture Proof of Delivery and receipts.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to use the microphone for voice expense notes.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to convert spoken expense notes into text.
